proposed_widenings.name: hp_pool resource
proposed_widenings.justification: Lay On Hands uses a numeric HP pool (5 × paladin level) that is spent in variable amounts per use. UseCountResource models discrete uses with a fixed or tiered cap; it cannot represent a pool where each activation drains an arbitrary player-chosen number of HP.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can restore a total number of Hit Points equal to five times your Paladin level … draw power from the pool of healing to restore a number of Hit Points to that creature, up to the maximum amount remaining in the pool

proposed_widenings.name: pool_bounded heal amount
proposed_widenings.justification: The heal is a player-chosen integer bounded by pool remainder — not a dice roll. DiceAmount (fixed / threshold_tiers / linear_per_level) exclusively represents dice expressions. A new variant like { kind: 'pool_bounded' } or { kind: 'variable_up_to_resource' } is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: restore a number of Hit Points to that creature, up to the maximum amount remaining in the pool

proposed_widenings.name: remove_condition in ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: remove_condition is a v4 atom (§9) but is not exposed in the ClassFeatureEffect union (currently GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect). The Poisoned-removal use requires it as an effect variant on a class feature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: expend 5 Hit Points from the pool of healing power to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature

proposed_widenings.name: multi-path activation on ClassFeatureActivationMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Lay On Hands can be activated in two distinct ways (heal HP OR remove condition) each consuming different amounts from the same pool. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has a single 'effect' field and cannot express two divergent activation paths sharing one resource.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action … restore a number of Hit Points … You can also expend 5 Hit Points … to remove the Poisoned condition

notes: The activation family is correct for this unit (bonus-action activated class feature with resource + long-rest reset). All gaps are surface-level type shapes — no new v4 atom is required. The deepest blocker is the resource model: UseCountResource cannot represent a variable-spend numeric HP pool. A new resource kind (hp_pool) and a corresponding non-dice heal amount variant are the minimum changes needed before a clean encoding is possible. The condition-removal secondary use and the dual-path structure are additional gaps that would surface once the resource type is widened.
